ev.q: AIDS incidence among MSM/IDU increased steadily from 1985 to 1992
Eighty-two percent of MSM/IDU had ever used noninjecting drugs
Seventy-six percent of MSM/IDU had sex with men during the 5 years preceding the interview
Non-Hispanic black and Hispanic men were overrepresented among MSM/IDU, accounting for half of MSM/IDU living with AIDS but 22% of the general male population.
Demographic and risk characteristics of MSM/IDU aged > 13 years with AIDS reported to CDC were obtained from AIDS surveillance data
SHAS is a cross-sectional interview study aimed at extending information routinely collected in AIDS surveillance.
